VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseA:
WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!
I bet you're surprised to see me here!
I made it all the way here, and it's all thanks to you!
{PLAYER}, losing to you that time made me stronger!
But I'm not going to lose anymore!
I'm going to win! For the POKéMON who gave me courage and strength!
Okay… Here I come!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat: Wow! {PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBat: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today, {PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll catch up to you!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro:
WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!
I've gotten stronger since that last time! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!
Okay… Here I come!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat: Wow! {PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle:
WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time, too… But one of these days, {PLAYER}, I'm going to catch up to you…
And challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro: I've made it this far a couple times, but the last stretch is so long…
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle: You've made it this far. Keep the momentum going and become the CHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro: I didn't come all this way to lose now. That possibility doesn't exist!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle:
I lost here…
That means I lack the qualifications to become the CHAMPION…
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro: This seemingly infinite and harsh road lives up to its name of VICTORY.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle: You seem to have the potential for becoming the CHAMPION.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro: What is the VICTORY ROAD? I'll tell you if you win!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle:
Getting through here safely--that's the final test for any TRAINER aiming to become the POKéMON CHAMPION.
That's why it's called the VICTORY ROAD.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro: I have nothing to say to anyone that's come this far. Come on!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle: Humph, go right on ahead. See if I care.
